question: Should OpenClaw retain HEARTBEAT.md as the public workspace filename while describing it as proactive behavior, or adopt a new canonical filename with a supported migration?
rationale: The proposed terminology improvement changes a shipped workspace and Gateway-facing contract, and repository evidence cannot determine whether the UX benefit outweighs upgrade and compatibility costs.

options.title: Keep file, clarify language
options.body: Retain HEARTBEAT.md as the stable contract and improve docs or UI copy so newcomers understand that heartbeats power proactive checks.

options.title: Rename with migration
options.body: Choose the exact new canonical casing and ship a doctor migration plus coordinated runtime, Gateway, template, documentation, and test updates.

options.title: Reject terminology change
options.body: Keep both the filename and current heartbeat terminology unchanged and close the request with that product decision.

recommendation.title: Keep file, clarify language
recommendation.body: Retain HEARTBEAT.md as the stable contract and improve docs or UI copy so newcomers understand that heartbeats power proactive checks.

likelyOwner.reason: Their existing issue review already owns the unresolved naming and compatibility decision.
